system.description:
Tracker. +1 Talent Die when tracking or investigating.

One Track Mind (Flaw). In a Combat Encounter you become obsessed with the enemy you target. Targeting a different enemy is at Minor Disadvantage until the obsession dies or is out of your view.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.83
